dialogues.speaker: Arayasa
dialogues.text: #"Fate weaves the web of the lost, yet {M#her}{F#his} journey is not deterred a sunrise or moonset."

dialogues.speaker: Arayasa
dialogues.text: "Drifting flowers gather in the embrace of Queen Aranyani, about to sing the song of dreams."

dialogues.speaker: Arayasa
dialogues.text: "The seed that was hidden in the shadow bloomed into starlight that even the high-hanging sun had never seen."

dialogues.speaker: Arayasa
dialogues.text: Thank you, Nara, for letting Arayasa listen to the song of Araji again.

dialogues.speaker: Arayasa
dialogues.text: #"To meet again in the land where trees flourish... Fate cannot catch up to {M#her}{F#his} footsteps."

dialogues.speaker: Arayasa
dialogues.text: "The sky graced with stars far and wide casts bright light. The birds of tireless tweets are a company to your sleep."

dialogues.speaker: Arayasa
dialogues.text: "...Singing your song forever is the pact between you and me."
